11 June 2026

Eurosystem staff macroeconomic projections for the euro area, June 2026

1 Overview

Inflation is projected to decline gradually, and growth is expected to recover over the projection horizon.

2 Macroeconomic projections for the euro area economy

2.1 Real economy

Real GDP growth is projected at 1.2% in 2026 and 1.4% in 2027.

3 Methodology

4 Disclaimer
